pep621.description: Refresh the sidecar uv.lock files (Build/decision, Build/reranker) weekly. Renovate tracks only the direct dependencies declared in pyproject.toml, so a transitive pin in uv.lock (filelock, setuptools, certifi) stays where it is until someone re-locks by hand; each of those three carried an advisory before it was raised. Scoped to pep621 so the npm lock files keep their current handling.

packageRules.description: Keep both sidecars on Python 3.14: the docker base image and the pep621 requires-python pin, which must move together. The images install their locked packages as wheels only, and PyYAML 6.0.3 (needed by transformers and huggingface-hub) publishes wheels only up to cp314, so a python 3.15 base cannot build (#1147) and uv cannot lock for ==3.15.* (#1153). Measured on PyPI 2026-10-31: PyYAML 6.0.3 is still the latest release with no cp315 wheel; every other compiled package in both uv.lock files has one in its latest release. Lift this rule once PyYAML ships a cp315 wheel for linux/x86_64.
